     1→class ContainerSyncJob < ApplicationJob
     2→  queue_as :default
     3→
     4→  def perform
     5→    Sandbox.active.where.not(container_id: nil).find_each do |sandbox|
     6→      sync_sandbox(sandbox)
     7→    end
     8→
     9→    User.where(tailscale_state: [ "enabled", "pending" ]).find_each do |user|
    10→      sync_tailscale_sidecar(user)
    11→    end
    12→
    13→    begin
    14→      RouteManager.new.sync_all_configs
    15→    rescue => e
    16→      Rails.logger.error("ContainerSyncJob: route sync failed: #{e.message}")
    17→    end
    18→
    19→    begin
    20→      TerminalManager.new.cleanup_orphaned
    21→    rescue => e
    22→      Rails.logger.error("ContainerSyncJob: terminal cleanup failed: #{e.message}")
    23→    end
    24→  end
    25→
    26→  private
    27→
    28→  def sync_sandbox(sandbox)
    29→    container = Docker::Container.get(sandbox.container_id)
    30→    actual_status = container.json.dig("State", "Running") ? "running" : "stopped"
    31→
    32→    if sandbox.status != actual_status
    33→      TerminalManager.new.close(sandbox: sandbox) rescue nil if actual_status == "stopped"
    34→      sandbox.update!(status: actual_status)
    35→      Rails.logger.info("ContainerSyncJob: #{sandbox.full_name} status corrected to #{actual_status}")
    36→    end
    37→  rescue Docker::Error::NotFoundError
    38→    TerminalManager.new.close(sandbox: sandbox) rescue nil
    39→    sandbox.update!(status: "destroyed", container_id: nil)
    40→    Rails.logger.warn("ContainerSyncJob: #{sandbox.full_name} container gone, marked destroyed")
    41→  end
    42→
    43→  def sync_tailscale_sidecar(user)
    44→    return if user.tailscale_container_id.blank?
    45→
    46→    Docker::Container.get(user.tailscale_container_id)
    47→  rescue Docker::Error::NotFoundError
    48→    user.update!(tailscale_state: "disabled", tailscale_container_id: nil, tailscale_network: nil)
    49→    user.sandboxes.active.where(tailscale: true).update_all(tailscale: false)
    50→    Rails.logger.warn("ContainerSyncJob: Tailscale sidecar for #{user.name} gone, marked disabled")
    51→  end
    52→end
    53→

     5→  def open
     6→    sandbox = if Current.user.admin?
     7→      Sandbox.active.find(params[:id])
     8→    else
     9→      Current.user.sandboxes.active.find(params[:id])
    10→    end
    11→
    12→    url = TerminalManager.new.open(sandbox: sandbox)
    13→    redirect_to url, allow_other_host: false
    14→  rescue TerminalManager::Error => e
    15→    redirect_to root_path, alert: e.message
    16→  end
    17→
    18→  def close
    19→    sandbox = if Current.user.admin?
    20→      Sandbox.active.find(params[:id])
    21→    else
    22→      Current.user.sandboxes.active.find(params[:id])
    23→    end
    24→
    25→    TerminalManager.new.close(sandbox: sandbox)

    27→  rescue TerminalManager::Error => e
    28→    redirect_to root_path, alert: e.message
    29→  end
    30→
    31→  # Called by Traefik forwardAuth — returns status code only, no body/redirect
    32→  def auth
    33→    forwarded_uri = request.headers["X-Forwarded-Uri"] || ""
    34→    match = forwarded_uri.match(%r{/terminal/(\d+)/wetty})
    35→    head(:unauthorized) and return unless match
    36→
    37→    session_record = find_session_by_cookie
    38→    head(:unauthorized) and return unless session_record
    39→
    40→    user = session_record.user
    41→    sandbox = Sandbox.active.find_by(id: match[1].to_i)
    42→    head(:forbidden) and return unless sandbox && (sandbox.user_id == user.id || user.admin?)
    43→
    44→    head :ok
    45→  end
    46→end
    47→

  "content": "class TerminalController < ApplicationController\n  allow_unauthenticated_access only: :auth\n  skip_before_action :require_password_change, only: :auth\n\n  def open\n    sandbox = if Current.user.admin?\n      Sandbox.active.find(params[:id])\n    else\n      Current.user.sandboxes.active.find(params[:id])\n    end\n\n    url = TerminalManager.new.open(sandbox: sandbox)\n    redirect_to url, allow_other_host: false, status: :see_other\n  rescue TerminalManager::Error => e\n    redirect_to root_path, alert: e.message\n  end\n\n  def close\n    sandbox = if Current.user.admin?\n      Sandbox.active.find(params[:id])\n    else\n      Current.user.sandboxes.active.find(params[:id])\n    end\n\n    TerminalManager.new.close(sandbox: sandbox)\n    redirect_to root_path, notice: \"Terminal closed\"\n  rescue TerminalManager::Error => e\n    redirect_to root_path, alert: e.message\n  end\n\n  # Called by Traefik forwardAuth — returns status code only, no body/redirect\n  def auth\n    forwarded_uri = request.headers[\"X-Forwarded-Uri\"] || \"\"\n    match = forwarded_uri.match(%r{/terminal/(\\d+)/wetty})\n    head(:unauthorized) and return unless match\n\n    session_record = find_session_by_cookie\n    head(:unauthorized) and return unless session_record\n\n    user = session_record.user\n    sandbox = Sandbox.active.find_by(id: match[1].to_i)\n    head(:unauthorized) and return unless sandbox && (sandbox.user_id == user.id || user.admin?)\n\n    head :ok\n  end\nend\n"
}

bob does NOT own alice_sandbox\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/#{@alice_sandbox.id}/wetty/\" }\n    assert_response :unauthorized\n  end\n\n  test \"auth returns 200 for admin accessing another user's sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/#{@bob_sandbox.id}/wetty/\" }\n    assert_response :ok\n  end\n\n  test \"auth returns 401 for non-existent sandbox ID\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/999999/wetty/\" }\n    assert_response :unauthorized\n  end\n\n  test \"auth returns 401 for destroyed sandbox\" do\n    destroyed = sandboxes(:alice_destroyed)\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/#{destroyed.id}/wetty/\" }\n    assert_response :unauthorized\n  end\n\n  test \"auth handles nested wetty paths\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/#{@alice_sandbox.id}/wetty/socket.io/?transport=websocket\" }\n    assert_response :ok\n  end\n\n  test \"auth returns 401 for path traversal attempt\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/../admin\" }\n    assert_response :unauthorized\n  end\n\n  test \"auth returns 200 for bob accessing his own sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@user)\n    get terminal_auth_path, headers: { \"X-Forwarded-Uri\" => \"/terminal/#{@bob_sandbox.id}/wetty/\" }\n    assert_response :ok\n  end\n\n  # ── open ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  test \"open requires authentication\" do\n    post terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    assert_redirected_to new_session_path\n  end\n\n  test \"open redirects to WeTTY URL on success\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n    url = \"/terminal/#{@alice_sandbox.id}/wetty\"\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub(open_result: url) do\n      post terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_response :see_other\n    assert_redirected_to url\n  end\n\n  test \"open returns 404 for another user's sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@user) # bob cannot access alice's sandbox\n    post terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    assert_response :not_found\n  end\n\n  test \"admin can open terminal for any sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub(open_result: \"/terminal/#{@bob_sandbox.id}/wetty\") do\n      post terminal_sandbox_path(@bob_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_response :see_other\n  end\n\n  test \"open redirects to root with alert on TerminalManager error\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub(open_error: \"Sandbox is not running\") do\n      post terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_redirected_to root_path\n    assert_equal \"Sandbox is not running\", flash[:alert]\n  end\n\n  # ── close ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────\n\n  test \"close requires authentication\" do\n    delete terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    assert_redirected_to new_session_path\n  end\n\n  test \"close redirects to root with notice on success\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub do\n      delete terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_redirected_to root_path\n    assert_equal \"Terminal closed\", flash[:notice]\n  end\n\n  test \"close returns 404 for another user's sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@user)\n    delete terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    assert_response :not_found\n  end\n\n  test \"admin can close terminal for any sandbox\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub do\n      delete terminal_sandbox_path(@bob_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_redirected_to root_path\n  end\n\n  test \"close redirects to root with alert on TerminalManager error\" do\n    sign_in_as(@admin)\n\n    with_terminal_manager_stub(close_error: \"Close failed\") do\n      delete terminal_sandbox_path(@alice_sandbox)\n    end\n\n    assert_redirected_to root_path\n    assert_equal \"Close failed\", flash[:alert]\n  end\n\n  private\n\n  def with_terminal_manager_stub(open_result: nil, open_error: nil, close_error: nil, &block)\n    stub = Object.new\n    stub.define_singleton_method(:open) do |sandbox:|\n      raise TerminalManager::Error, open_error if open_error\n      open_result\n    end\n    stub.define_singleton_method(:close) do |sandbox:|\n      raise TerminalManager::Error, close_error if close_error\n    end\n\n    original_new = TerminalManager.method(:new)\n    TerminalManager.define_singleton_method(:new) { stub }\n    begin\n      yield\n    ensure\n      TerminalManager.define_singleton_method(:new, original_new)\n    end\n  end\nend\n"

   179→    pubkey = File.read(File.join(key_dir, "key.pub")).strip
   180→    username = sandbox.user.name
   181→
   182→    container = Docker::Container.get(sandbox.container_id)
   183→
   184→    # Use discrete exec commands to avoid shell injection via string interpolation
   185→    container.exec([ "mkdir", "-p", "/home/#{username}/.ssh" ])
   186→    container.exec([ "sh", "-c", "cat >> /home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys" ], stdin: StringIO.new("#{pubkey}\n"))
   187→    container.exec([ "chown", "-R", "#{username}:#{username}", "/home/#{username}/.ssh" ])
   188→    container.exec([ "chmod", "600", "/home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys" ])
   189→  end
   190→
   191→  def create_wetty_container(sandbox:, user:, key_dir:)
   192→    container_name = wetty_container_name(sandbox)
   193→
   194→    # Remove any existing container with this name
   195→    begin
   196→      old = Docker::Container.get(container_name)
   197→      old.stop(t: 3) rescue nil
   198→      old.delete(force: true)
   199→    rescue Docker::Error::NotFoundError
   200→      # No existing container
   201→    end
   202→
   203→    key_path = File.join(key_dir, "key")
   204→
   205→    container = Docker::Container.create(
   206→      "name" => container_name,
   207→      "Image" => WETTY_IMAGE,
   208→      "Env" => [
   209→        "SSHHOST=#{sandbox.full_name}",
   210→        "SSHPORT=22",
   211→        "SSHUSER=#{user.name}",
   212→        "SSHAUTH=publickey",
   213→        "SSHKEY=/etc/wetty/key",
   214→        "BASE=/terminal/#{sandbox.id}/wetty"
   215→      ],
   216→      "HostConfig" => {
   217→        "NetworkMode" => NETWORK_NAME,
   218→        "Binds" => [ "#{key_path}:/etc/wetty/key:ro" ],
   219→        "RestartPolicy" => { "Name" => "no" },
   220→        "Memory" => 128 * 1024 * 1024, # 128MB
   221→        "NanoCpus" => 500_000_000 # 0.5 CPU
   222→      },
   223→      "Labels" => {
   224→        "sandcastle.sandbox_id" => sandbox.id.to_s,
   225→        "sandcastle.role" => "wetty"
   226→      }
   227→    )
   228→
   229→    container.start
   230→    container
   231→  end
   232→
   233→  def write_traefik_config(sandbox)
   234→    FileUtils.mkdir_p(DYNAMIC_DIR)
   235→
   236→    host = ENV.fetch("SANDCASTLE_HOST", "localhost")
   237→    id = sandbox.id
   238→    container_name = wetty_container_name(sandbox)
   239→
   240→    rule = if ENV["SANDCASTLE_TLS_MODE"] == "selfsigned"
   241→      "HostRegexp(`.+`) && PathPrefix(`/terminal/#{id}/wetty`)"
   242→    else
   243→      "Host(`#{host}`) && PathPrefix(`/terminal/#{id}/wetty`)"
   244→    end
   245→
   246→    config = {
   247→      "http" => {
   248→        "routers" => {
   249→          "terminal-#{id}" => {
   250→            "rule" => rule,
   251→            "service" => "terminal-#{id}",
   252→            "entryPoints" => [ "websecure" ],
   253→            "tls" => tls_config,
   254→            "middlewares" => [ "terminal-auth-#{id}" ],
   255→            "priority" => 100
   256→          }
   257→        },
   258→        "middlewares" => {
   259→          "terminal-auth-#{id}" => {
   260→            "forwardAuth" => {
   261→              "address" => "http://sandcastle-web:80/terminal/auth",
   262→              "trustForwardHeader" => true
   263→            }
   264→          }
   265→        },
   266→        "services" => {
   267→          "terminal-#{id}" => {
   268→            "loadBalancer" => {
   269→              "servers" => [ { "url" => "http://#{container_name}:3000" } ]
   270→            }
   271→          }
   272→        }
   273→      }
   274→    }
   275→
   276→    File.write(File.join(DYNAMIC_DIR, "terminal-#{id}.yml"), config.to_yaml)
   277→  end
   278→
   279→  def tls_config
   280→    if ENV["SANDCASTLE_TLS_MODE"] == "selfsigned"
   281→      {}
   282→    else
   283→      { "certResolver" => "letsencrypt" }
   284→    end
   285→  end
   286→
   287→  def delete_traefik_config(sandbox)
   288→    path = File.join(DYNAMIC_DIR, "terminal-#{sandbox.id}.yml")
   289→    File.delete(path) if File.exist?(path)
   290→  end
   291→
   292→  def remove_pubkey(sandbox)
   293→    return unless sandbox.container_id.present?
   294→
   295→    begin
   296→      container = Docker::Container.get(sandbox.container_id)
   297→      username = sandbox.user.name
   298→      marker = "wetty-#{sandbox.full_name}"
   299→      # Use grep -vF (fixed string) to avoid regex injection via sed
   300→      container.exec([
   301→        "sh", "-c",
   302→        "grep -vF '#{marker}' /home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys > /tmp/ak_clean && " \
   303→        "mv /tmp/ak_clean /home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys || true"
   304→      ])
   305→    rescue Docker::Error::NotFoundError, Docker::Error::DockerError
   306→      # Sandbox container gone or exec failed — best-effort
   307→    end
   308→  end
   309→end
   310→

# Puma starts a configurable number of processes (workers) and each process

# You can control the number of workers using ENV["WEB_CONCURRENCY"]. You
# should only set this value when you want to run 2 or more workers. The
# default is already 1. You can set it to `auto` to automatically start a worker
# for each available processor.
#
# The ideal number of threads per worker depends both on how much time the
# application spends waiting for IO operations and on how much you wish to
# prioritize throughput over latency.
#
# As a rule of thumb, increasing the number of threads will increase how much
# traffic a given process can handle (throughput), but due to CRuby's
# Global VM Lock (GVL) it has diminishing returns and will degrade the
# response time (latency) of the application.
#
# The default is set to 3 threads as it's deemed a decent compromise between
# throughput and latency for the average Rails application.
#
# Any libraries that use a connection pool or another resource pool should
# be configured to provide at least as many connections as the number of
# threads. This includes Active Record's `pool` parameter in `database.yml`.

> AGENT

Found it. **`container.exec` with `stdin: StringIO` is hanging.** The `docker-api` gem's `exec` with stdin doesn't work properly — `cat` reads from stdin but the API never sends EOF, so `cat` waits forever.

Let me fix the `inject_pubkey` method to not use stdin piping. I'll use a simpler approach with `echo` or `tee`.

> TOOL

> AGENT

The `stdin: StringIO` approach doesn't work with the `docker-api` gem. SSH public keys are safe for shell interpolation (they're `algorithm base64 comment` with no special chars), but let me use `tee -a` approach which is safe and doesn't need stdin piping. Actually, the safest non-stdin approach is writing to a temp file then appending:

> TOOL

tool_use Edit
id: toolu_01PKFjUMBaagLsd6DNHioWMA
```json
{
  "replace_all": false,
  "file_path": "/Users/thies/Projects/GitHub/Sandcastle/app/services/terminal_manager.rb",
  "old_string": "  def inject_pubkey(sandbox, key_dir)\n    pubkey = File.read(File.join(key_dir, \"key.pub\")).strip\n    username = sandbox.user.name\n\n    container = Docker::Container.get(sandbox.container_id)\n\n    # Use discrete exec commands to avoid shell injection via string interpolation\n    container.exec([ \"mkdir\", \"-p\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh\" ])\n    container.exec([ \"sh\", \"-c\", \"cat >> /home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys\" ], stdin: StringIO.new(\"#{pubkey}\\n\"))\n    container.exec([ \"chown\", \"-R\", \"#{username}:#{username}\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh\" ])\n    container.exec([ \"chmod\", \"600\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys\" ])\n  end",
  "new_string": "  def inject_pubkey(sandbox, key_dir)\n    pubkey = File.read(File.join(key_dir, \"key.pub\")).strip\n    username = sandbox.user.name\n\n    container = Docker::Container.get(sandbox.container_id)\n\n    # Write pubkey via base64 to avoid any shell-injection risk.\n    # The stdin: approach hangs because docker-api never sends EOF to cat.\n    encoded = Base64.strict_encode64(\"#{pubkey}\\n\")\n    container.exec([ \"mkdir\", \"-p\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh\" ])\n    container.exec([ \"sh\", \"-c\", \"echo #{encoded} | base64 -d >> /home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys\" ])\n    container.exec([ \"chown\", \"-R\", \"#{username}:#{username}\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh\" ])\n    container.exec([ \"chmod\", \"600\", \"/home/#{username}/.ssh/authorized_keys\" ])\n  end"
}
```

Now I understand the setup. For local dev with `selfsigned` TLS mode, we need:
1. A Traefik static config with self-signed certs
2. A Traefik container on the `sandcastle-web` network
3. The `SANDCASTLE_TLS_MODE=selfsigned` env var

Let me set this up. First, create the Traefik config and self-signed certs, then start Traefik, and update the Rails env.

{
  "command": "# Create traefik directories and self-signed cert via the sandcastle-web container (which has /data mounted)\ndocker exec sandcastle-web bash -c '\nmkdir -p /data/traefik/certs\n# Generate self-signed cert for localhost\nopenssl req -x509 -nodes -days 365 -newkey ec -pkeyopt ec_paramgen_curve:prime256v1 \\\n  -keyout /data/traefik/certs/key.pem \\\n  -out /data/traefik/certs/cert.pem \\\n  -subj \"/CN=localhost\" \\\n  -addext \"subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1\" 2>/dev/null\necho \"Cert generated\"\nls -la /data/traefik/certs/\n' 2>&1",
  "description": "Generate self-signed cert for local Traefik"
}
```

  "content": "# Fix WeTTY Terminal: Get it working in local Docker\n\n## Context\nWeTTY terminal implementation is complete (code, tests, UI all done). The blocker is the local Docker networking: Traefik needs to route `/terminal/{id}/wetty` to the WeTTY sidecar container, but the local setup is missing Traefik and has network mismatches.\n\n## Root Causes Found\n1. **`inject_pubkey` hangs** — `container.exec` with `stdin: StringIO` never sends EOF → fixed with base64 pipe approach\n2. **No Traefik locally** — production has Traefik as a Kamal accessory; local Docker Compose doesn't\n3. **Network mismatch** — `sandcastle-web` container is on `sandcastle_default` network, not `sandcastle-web` network where Traefik + WeTTY live\n4. **TLS mode** — dynamic configs need `SANDCASTLE_TLS_MODE=selfsigned` for local dev (no Let's Encrypt)\n\n## Plan\n1. Connect `sandcastle-web` to `sandcastle-web` Docker network (so Traefik can reach Rails)\n2. Verify Traefik container (`sandcastle-traefik`) can reach `sandcastle-web:80`\n3. Set `SANDCASTLE_TLS_MODE=selfsigned` in the running Rails container and restart\n4. Regenerate dynamic Traefik configs in self-signed mode\n5. Verify WeTTY container is running (restart if needed)\n6. Open `https://localhost:8443` in Chrome, click Terminal, verify WeTTY shell appears\n7. If anything fails, check `docker logs` and fix iteratively\n\n## Files to touch\n- `app/services/terminal_manager.rb` — already fixed (base64 inject_pubkey)\n- Docker runtime config only (no code changes expected)\n"
}
```
